title: Source
description: A discovered source. Core identity from 199-biotechnologies (source_id = sha256(canonical_locator)[:16]); provenance fields describe how the acquisition engine found it. Lives in acquisition/sources.jsonl (merged) and per-agent fragments.

source_id.description: sha256(canonical_locator)[:16] — stable across edits, continuation, and re-acquisition

canonical_locator.description: Canonical identifier: doi:10.1038/..., arxiv:2305.14251, or normalized URL (scheme+host+path, no fragment/tracking params)

raw_url.description: Original URL as retrieved, before normalization

published.description: Publication date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD or full timestamp); null if unknown — never guessed

retrieved.description: Date the content was fetched, ISO 8601

origin.description: Epistemic distance from the event/fact: primary (original records, data, filings, first reporting), secondary (analysis/reports about primary material), tertiary (aggregations, encyclopedias, SEO content)

medium.description: What kind of resource it is (199-biotechnologies' source_type enum)

metadata_status.description: How far metadata has been verified

search_angle.description: Slug of the planned search angle that produced this source (e.g. french-government-records)

discovered_by.description: Identifier of the acquisition agent that first registered it (e.g. acquisition-agent-03)

raw_file.description: Path of the extracted full text relative to acquisition/ (e.g. raw/a03-001.md)

registered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when source was registered
